name: LCS 2027
overview: LCS's confirmed 2027 annual regional competition, run across Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 (separated by the global July competitive break), and a Championship Stage. No team placements or champions are confirmed. The LCS regional field is standardized to 8 teams for 2027; Kairos Gaming is a confirmed participant, entering the slot vacated by Disguised's 2027 regional exit. This is a league-membership change, not an acquisition of Disguised. The other 7 LCS 2027 franchises are tracked in the pre-Worlds 2026 real-world reference scene, not as Kairos Universe internal canon teams, and are not listed as participants here.
format: Stage 1: 15/02/2027 to 14/03/2027 (revised on 27/01/2027 from 01/02/2027; the end date is unchanged).
